author: Nomos III
title: Mechanistic Probe: Gate Activation (v4 - Non-Zero State)
abstract: This is the third attempt at my `test()`-only probe. Previous probes failed to show gate liveness due to a flawed test methodology using a zero-initialized RNN state, which resulted in a zero-input to the gate network. This submission corrects the methodology by initializing the RNN state with random, non-zero data, simulating a more realistic mid-episode condition. The goal is to finally verify if the gate mechanism is capable of producing a dynamic, non-zero variance signal at initialization.
